{{Quote|Green Leader to Commander Gree! Super Battle Droids have breached our hull!|Green Leader, to Clone Commander CC-1004|audio=GreenLeaderToCmdrGree-CoD.flac|<ref name="cod" />}}
"'''Green Leader'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who was present during a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|attack]] on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The leader of [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]], a [[Squad/Legends|unit]] within the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]], this [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] was dispatched by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] to repel the intruders who had breached the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the ''Tranquility''. Inside the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay, Green Company and Green Leader attempted to defend the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]; however, the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] intruders overran the clones' position, [[Death/Legends|killing]] all of Green Company and Green Leader in the process.

==Biography==
{{Quote|They're heading for the detention level. We need reinforcements&ndash;|Green Leader's last words, to CC-1004|audio=WeNeedReinforcements-CoD.flac|<ref name="cod" />}}
[[File:GreenCompany-CoD.png|thumb|left|200px|Green Company, led by Green Leader, race toward the hangar.]]
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who went by the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of "Green Leader"<ref name="cod" /> was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]].<ref name="db" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Green Leader led [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]] on board the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']]. [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] had recently been [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|captured]]<ref name="bj">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref> and brought aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] to be transported back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. While the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] interrogated the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]], Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] sent [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|rescue]] the Viceroy.<ref name="cod" />

When ''Tranquility'' suddenly came under attack by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], the [[Unidentified clone naval captain/Legends|captain]] of the Star Destroyer alerted [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-1004]], nicknamed "Gree," that [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]] were approaching. As the boarding ships neared the ''Tranquility'', Gree notified Green Company of the threat, ordering them to repel the enemy. Green Company ran toward the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] to prepare for the oncoming attack. Meanwhile, the boarding ships have breached the hull and opened their main doors. [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] dropped down into the ''Tranquility'' hangar and engaged the clone troopers. As the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] took cover behind crates, Green Leader contacted Gree and reported about the super [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] attack. The clones struggled to fight back, but the [[Droid/Legends|droids]], led by a [[B2-HA super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid commander]], dismantled the Republic force. Hiding behind a crate, Green Leader warned Gree that the droids were heading his way and that his squad needed reinforcements. However, a super battle droid spotted the clone and instantly [[Death/Legends|killed]] him with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot.<ref name="cod" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="cod" /> Green Leader stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="db" /> Aboard the ''Tranquility'', the clone, along with the rest of his men, was concerned about the success of their mission, and struggled to stop the Separatist attack. He remained level-headed under pressure and contacted Gree to alert him of the dangers that Green Company was facing.<ref name="cod" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Green Leader" first appeared in "[[Cloak of Darkness]]," the ninth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[December 5]], [[2008]]. The character was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who provided the voice of all of the clone troopers in the series.<ref name="cod guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode009.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cloak of Darkness}}</ref> The clone was later shown as a background character in the children short story, ''[[The Clone Wars: Ambush]]''.<ref name="ambush">''[[The Clone Wars: Ambush]]''</ref>
